note: Recorded from the real run in docs/spike-results.md: Tatum Sui testnet, Walrus Memory via the mainnet relayer. The saved memory is labelled demo. The reason text is tidied for display; the original test run saved it with different wording.

decision.reason: Too large for someone I have never paid.

steps.title: Empty memory
steps.caption: A first send of 0.5 SUI to a new recipient. Nothing is remembered, so there is nothing to say.

steps.title: You say no
steps.caption: You deny it and type why. The reason is saved to Walrus Memory. This took about 25 seconds, and a denied send never touches the chain.

steps.title: The same send again
steps.caption: The same 0.5 SUI send to a new recipient. Your own reason is quoted back to you, with the receipt.

steps.title: After a real send
steps.caption: A confirmed 0.01 SUI send went through Tatum. Your usual size is now 0.01 SUI, so the same 0.5 SUI send is 50 times larger. It still matches your refusal exactly.

steps.title: A much smaller send
steps.caption: 0.01 SUI to a new recipient is only a partial match: same newness and hour, very different size.
